[F299(ld) [F300Any compound (not being a compound for the time being specified in sub-paragraphs

linking group and the naphthyl ring, are linked together in a similar manner, whether or not
any of the sub-structures have been modified, and whether or not substituted in any of the
linked sub-structures with a benzyl or phenyl group and whether or not such compound
is further substituted to any extent with alkyl, alkenyl, alkoxy, halide, haloalkyl or cyano

of the sub-structures are limited to any of the following, that is to say—]

or pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine;

cycloalkylethyl, ( N-methylpiperidin-2-yl)methyl, 2-(4-morpholinyl)ethyl or
(tetrahydropyran-4-yl)methyl;
(iii) replacement of the methanone linking group with an ethanone, carboxamide,
